notes: Original research article; record.json is_retracted false and no retraction notice in the PDF text. H2 uptake measured by the authors on a Sieverts apparatus at 77 K and 298 K, 0-20 bar (Table 2, Fig. 6), labelled 'excess'. Carbon sorbents: KOH-activated porous carbons SBL-CO-PP-C-7 and SBL-CO-PP-C-20 (BET 2679 and 2330 m2/g, Table 1, same samples as the H2 data). Borderline point for I2: EDS (main p. 8, journal p. 32804) gives C 52.01, N 36.22, O 7.80 at.% for C-7 and C 56.10, N 43.90 at.% for C-20, which is about 50% and 52% carbon by mass on the listed elements (EDS does not detect H); the paper calls both 'porous carbon', so I2 is coded met, with C-20 the clearer case. The polymer and polymer-composite samples (CO-PP-0, SBL-CO-PP-7, SBL-CO-PP-20) are not carbon-majority but are not needed for I2. SBL-PNP-0.25-4-750 uptake in Fig. S2 comes from the authors' earlier paper; the new materials' H2 values are reported as this work, so duplicate_data does not apply.
